stem: Which sentence provides information needed to complete both the cause and effect portions of this diagram?

options.label: F
options.text: The 1898 Spanish-American War led to world power status for the United States.

options.label: G
options.text: The 1914 opening of the Panama Canal encouraged international trade.

options.label: H
options.text: The 1919 Treaty of Versailles contributed to the start of World War II in Europe.

options.label: J
options.text: The 1929 stock-market crash set off the Great Depression in the United States.

visual_elements: Diagram with a center box listing: U.S. control of the Philippines, Cuban independence, U.S. control of Puerto Rico, U.S. control of Guam; an arrow labeled Cause pointing to the box from a rectangle with a question mark; an arrow labeled Effect pointing from the box to an oval with a question mark.
